paper.title: Qwen-Planner-Agent: A Closed-Loop AI-for-AI Framework for Real-World Mobile Planner Agents
paper.central_claim: 提出闭环“AI-for-AI”框架开发移动端 Planner Agent：AI 辅助任务构造/失败诊断→数据飞轮、课程式能力自适应 RL(CARE)、模型–Harness（Skills+Memory+反馈）共进化；Qwen-Planner-Agent 27B 在 MobilePA-Bench 上 Overall 77.05%，居所评估模型之首且输出成本较低。

provenance.session_receipt_note: worker has no session/receipt handle exposed; model name taken from system prompt
provenance.blind_boundary_note: No seat/aggregate/archive/old score read. research/patterns/assignments.jsonl was only grepped as a queue hint (truncated lines for 5 of 6 papers were displayed); its fit notes were not used as evidence and all pattern calls below were made from full text.

evidence.quote: The agent primarily acts through structured tools rather than pixel-coordinate GUI actions, although tools may return visual observations when needed.
evidence.support_explanation: 范围判定的关键：动作面是类型化工具调用，而非屏幕上的 GUI 操作

evidence.quote: Qwen-Planner-Agent focuses on this planning problem rather than introducing a new screen-grounding architecture.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自述不做屏幕 grounding

evidence.quote: Tasks start from controlled initial states; completion is verified through tool calls, terminal state changes, or agent behavior.
evidence.support_explanation: MobilePA-Bench 的验证方式：工具调用/终态变化

evidence.quote: Agent-backed capabilities and atomic tools enter the same structured action interface
evidence.support_explanation: “sub-agent”会话作为工具暴露；其内部是否为 GUI agent 未在材料中说明

evidence.quote: Within this framework, AI interprets execution feedback to identify capability gaps and guide coordinated updates to training data, learning strategies, and runtime support.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张（AI-for-AI 闭环）

evidence.quote: Model parameters remain fixed during serving; offline updates are validated and versioned, with human review retained for ambiguous and release-critical decisions.
evidence.support_explanation: 更新为离线、版本化、人工把关——无服务期自我改进

evidence.quote: Feedback thus determines both which data to select and which tasks to construct next.
evidence.support_explanation: 反馈驱动的数据选择/任务构造

evidence.quote: A bounded LLM-based controller periodically configures the predefined scheduling parameters from recent training statistics and held-out development-set feedback.
evidence.support_explanation: CARE 调度参数由 LLM 控制器依据开发集反馈配置

evidence.quote: A task-specific rule-based verifier or rubric-guided generative reward model assigns each trajectory a binary success indicator
evidence.support_explanation: 奖励来自规则验证器或 rubric 生成式奖励模型（未见人工校验）

evidence.quote: Without advantage calibration, outputs become shorter but training accuracy remains substantially lower over the plotted interval.
evidence.support_explanation: CARE 优势校准消融（仅训练曲线、读图）
主结果 Overall 77.05
最强闭源对照仅差 0.21 点
同骨干未训练基线

evidence.quote: Holding the 27B checkpoint fixed, the Harness raises Overall from 71.90% to 77.05%
evidence.support_explanation: 固定检查点的 Harness 配对增益

evidence.quote: The updated policy is then evaluated under the same harness on a held-out evolve set, which serves as the development set for co-evolution rather than an independent final test set.
evidence.support_explanation: 共进化表的评测集同时是驱动 Harness 修订的开发集

evidence.quote: Model–Harness Co-evolution | 88.50 | 89.76 | 88.69 | 82.42 | 46.98
evidence.support_explanation: 共进化结果（开发集）
对照臂

evidence.quote: Costs are estimated from mean output tokens per task, including thinking tokens, and the corresponding output-token rates.
evidence.support_explanation: 成本仅估输出 token

evidence.quote: We present this mechanism as a development pathway rather than claiming that sustained autonomous co-evolution has already been established.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自我限定：共进化未被证明

evidence.quote: and several individual pairs show small regressions
evidence.support_explanation: Harness 记忆在短历史基准上持平/个别倒退

evidence.quote: MobilePA-bench: benchmarking mobile planner agents on complex real-world tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 评测基准 MobilePA-Bench 来自同一作者群（参考文献 [11] 作者与贡献者名单重叠）
全文查找：多种子/置信区间、judge 校验、Harness 的单变量消融（Skills vs Memory）——未报告

scope_review.reason: EVIDENCE.md 不收录“没有 GUI 或浏览器操作面的纯 API / function-calling agent”。本文策略以类型化工具调用为动作面（Q001），MobilePA-Bench 以工具调用/终态变化验证（Q003），作者明确不做屏幕 grounding（Q002）；GUI 操作至多经“sub-agent 会话”间接出现，材料中未描述其 GUI 感知/动作（Q004）。
scope_review.counter_consideration: 数据来自“程序化沙箱+LLM 模拟+真机会话”三后端且含 App 内操作；若总控判定“真机会话上的手机操作”足以构成操作面，应改判 in-scope 并重评，本席已保留全部临时分析以便复用。
scope_review.ask_controller: 请总控裁定范围；未得裁定前本记录 score=null。

signatures.object: 训练数据飞轮：任务构造 agent→自动 rollout→质检/人审→按能力与稳定性重加权
signatures.information: 训练 rollout 反馈 + 开发集（不入训练）按能力的失败分布；验证器可看特权状态证据而策略看不到
signatures.operation: 对已掌握任务下采样、对不稳定任务上采样、对缺失能力生成新任务；人审门控每个版本
signatures.output: 版本化数据配置（任务增删、采样权重）
signatures.conditions: 需要可复位任务与可靠完成判据
signatures.feedback: 任务级 rollout 分析 + 能力级开发集结果
signatures.selection_rule/data: 分析 agent 提议 → 人类批准/修改/拒绝 → 冻结下一轮
signatures.persistence: 版本化数据集与采样配置
signatures.claimed_effect: 未单独量化数据飞轮的收益（无关闭消融）
signatures.failure_boundary: 无“无飞轮 vs 有飞轮”对照；人审介入程度未量化

signatures.object: CARE：按组成功率切换奖励机制（进度塑形/结果巩固/效率精炼）+ 效率态优势地板
signatures.information: 组内成功率 s̄、开发集指标；LLM 控制器仅配置预设参数
signatures.operation: 三段奖励 + σ_anchor 地板避免成功饱和组的效率差被标准化放大
signatures.output: 更短输出（-32.5% token）而训练准确率与 vanilla RL 相当
signatures.conditions: 需二值验证器；阈值 p_low/p_high 由 LLM 控制器周期配置
signatures.selection_rule/data: LLM 控制器每 N 步依据开发集选参数
signatures.claimed_effect: 训练曲线上 token 减少 32.5%，去掉校准则准确率明显偏低
signatures.failure_boundary: 仅 4 个训练环境平滑曲线，无最终测试集消融，无多种子

signatures.object: 部署时 Harness（Scenario Adapter 技能 + 持久记忆 + 反馈）与离线 LLM 编辑的 Harness 修订
signatures.information: 工具清单、检索到的记忆、历史；记忆仅作证据不授予权限
signatures.operation: 按可见工具编译技能指引；记忆捕获→验证→索引→检索→巩固→修订；交替“RL 训练模型/LLM 改 Harness 指令”
signatures.output: 更新后的 η（指令配置）与 θ（权重）
signatures.conditions: 服务期参数固定，更新离线、人审、版本化
signatures.selection_rule/data: LLM 编辑者依据开发集反馈修订 Harness；是否保留由人审/规则检查决定
signatures.persistence: 版本化指令配置 + 记忆库
signatures.later_use: 下一轮训练 rollout 与服务
signatures.failure_boundary: 评测集=开发集（Q015）；Skills 与 Memory 的各自贡献未拆分；无多种子

retention_trace.before: 模型 θ(k)、Harness 指令 η(k)（k 轮）
retention_trace.proposed_change: RL 更新 θ；LLM 编辑者基于开发集失败诊断修订 η；数据飞轮提议任务增删/权重调整
retention_trace.selection_data_rule: 开发集（evolve 集，不入训练）结果 + 规则检查 + 人审批准（Q006/Q015）
retention_trace.persisted_change: 版本化 η、数据配置、权重；记忆库
retention_trace.measured_gain: MobilePA-Internal 82.67→88.50（4 轮）；MCPMark 38.00→46.98（3 轮）——均在选择用的开发集上（Q015/Q016）
retention_trace.verdict: task improvement 在开发集上；retained improvement（独立测试集上）与 improver improvement 未示；不可称 retained。

gap.author_gap: 需要把执行经验转成对数据、训练、运行时支持的协同改进；真机交互昂贵、难并行（Q005 及 §1）。
gap.checked_gap: 问题陈述偏方法论（“AI 参与开发 AI”），具体瓶颈（移动 planner 的 Tool/Memory/Skill/Sub-agent 能力）取决于其自家基准 MobilePA-Bench（Q021）；与 GUI 感知—动作环路的关系间接。

lineage.closest_adjacent: 正文引述的上述方法；本席未取得其全文，固定最近邻核查不完整。

gap.residue: 自述为开发路径而非已证实的持续共进化（Q019）。
gap.stakes: 无独立测试集 → 共进化收益未被证明可迁移。
gap.method_response: 三阶段闭环+版本化人审。
gap.remaining_gap: 独立测试集上的共进化收益；Skills/Memory/Harness 编辑各自的因果；GUI 层面能力。
unresolved: 最近邻原文未固定，gap 仅为临时判断；范围未裁定。
